verdict.rationale: The evidence shows QuickBooks Online exposes a full read/write API (OAuth SDKs, PHP SDK, and an official MCP server with 145 tools covering CRUD for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports), which technically allows a user to pull out all their data programmatically in JSON. However, there is no documented one-click 'export all data' feature, no confirmation of standard open formats like CSV/Excel/IIF for a full migration, and community commentary only mentions QBO lacking desktop feature parity, not data portability. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data export/migration feature, documented open export file formats, and any evidence of ease of full account extraction without per-entity API calls.
